feedback: Yasirunin, your enthusiasm for front-end development and your project, the learning portal, is clear. However, to effectively communicate your ideas, focus on organizing your thoughts and using professional vocabulary to describe your experiences and skills.
strengths: Having a project that demonstrates your skills
weaknesses: Lack of clarity in expressing thoughts
suggestions: Practice speaking about your projects in a structured way, starting with an introduction, then details, and finally the outcome
Learn and use technical terms related to front-end development to describe your work
Prepare examples of challenges you faced and how you overcame them to show problem-solving skills
Record yourself speaking about your projects and listen to identify areas for improvement
better_answer_example: Hello, my name is Yasirunin, and I'm excited about front-end development. Recently, I worked on a learning portal project that aimed to enhance educational experiences. The project involved designing UI components and integrating them with HTML and CSS. Although we encountered some issues, I was able to learn from them and successfully complete the project. This experience not only deepened my understanding of front-end technologies but also taught me the importance of perseverance in software development.
